verdict.rationale: Brex marketing states it can 'automate GL coding by entity globally' alongside one-click accruals to 'close the books every day', which matches the multi-entity, close-acceleration core of the story. However, the only support is short marketing taglines. The AI part is only implied by general 'AI-powered financial operations' messaging, not tied to GL coding. missing for 10: explicit evidence that AI/ML performs the GL code assignment, in-depth first-party documentation of how auto-coding works across entities (rules, accuracy, ERP sync), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
